none: PAS FindID 995512: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), probably Fallen Horseman, issue of 355-361, Reece period 18; chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN [----]. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman, horseman may have pleated garb or lamellar armour. Reverse inscription: [F]EL TEM[P REPARATIO].…
